author: nottherealtar
install_msg: MEE6-style level roles. **Requires `serverassistant` loaded** with leveling enabled. Start with `[p]levelrole` help, then `levelrole add 5 @Role`.
name: levelroles
short: Level role rewards using ServerAssistant XP
description: Grants roles at ServerAssistant level thresholds. No second XP system — reads XP from serverassistant. Supports stack mode, unlock announcements, and sync/rejoin.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-guild level-to-role reward mappings and an optional announce channel id. It does not store user XP (reads ServerAssistant).
